title: Emperor Penguin Paani Mein 535m Gehrai Tak Kaise Jaata Hai? 🐧 #shorts
idea: Emperor penguins can dive to extreme depths of 535 meters and hold their breath for 20 minutes by lowering their heart rate to 15 bpm.

lines.text: Kya koi bird samundar mein 535 meter gehrai tak ja sakti hai?
Emperor Penguin paani ke andar 20 minute tak bina saans liye rehta hai.
Ye 535 meter neeche jaakar aasaani se shikaar kar sakta hai.
Diving ke dauran iska heart rate ghat kar 15 beats per minute ho jata hai!
Iske alawa inki solid bones high pressure se inhen bachati hain.
Kya aap paani me 1 minute saans rok sakte ho? Comment me batao!

facts.claim: Emperor penguins can remain submerged underwater for around 20 minutes and dive to 535 meters depth.
Their heart rate slows down to 15-20 beats per minute during deep dives.
